pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygons with jagged, non-linear edges. Patches on the upper neck are larger and more elongated, while flank and hindquarter patches are smaller and more fragmented with high edge complexity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological network of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are frequent and complex, with pathway thickness varying significantly between large neck patches and smaller clusters on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude vertical silhouette along the cervical ridge, representing a dense, short-haired mane with a uniform height and sharp pixel-gradient against the background.
